reconnaissance.label: Reconnaissance
reconnaissance.description: Adversaries gather information about the target organization, assets, identities, or network to prepare follow-on activity.

resource-development.label: Resource Development
resource-development.description: Adversaries create, purchase, or control infrastructure, accounts, and capabilities to support later operations.

initial-access.label: Initial Access
initial-access.description: Adversaries attempt to enter the target environment and establish an entry point into systems or networks.

execution.label: Execution
execution.description: Adversaries run malicious code, commands, or tooling on local or remote systems.

persistence.label: Persistence
persistence.description: Adversaries maintain access so they do not lose control after restarts, credential changes, or other interruptions.

privilege-escalation.label: Privilege Escalation
privilege-escalation.description: Adversaries exploit vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, or credentials to gain higher privileges.

defense-evasion.label: Defense Evasion
defense-evasion.description: Adversaries hide activity, bypass detections, or weaken security controls.

credential-access.label: Credential Access
credential-access.description: Adversaries attempt to steal account names, passwords, tokens, or other credential material.

discovery.label: Discovery
discovery.description: Adversaries enumerate systems, networks, accounts, and security configuration to understand the environment.

lateral-movement.label: Lateral Movement
lateral-movement.description: Adversaries move through the environment to access additional systems or critical assets.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Adversaries gather files, credentials, screen content, or business data from the target environment.

command-and-control.label: Command and Control
command-and-control.description: Adversaries establish remote control channels to communicate with compromised systems.

exfiltration.label: Exfiltration
exfiltration.description: Adversaries transfer data out of the target environment through networks, media, or control channels.

impact.label: Impact
